figures.finding: Taiwan's Ministry of Culture funds features through its long-film subsidy (長片輔導金); its "International Flagship" track pays up to NT$100 million a project (three films chosen in the first 2026 round), and TAICCA's story-development scheme up to NT$6 million (5 of 52 applications chosen in its first year).

value.body: 文化部 (Ministry of Culture); 文化內容策進院 (TAICCA)

sources.said: 文化部今（21）日宣布，2026年首波「大航海計畫」長片輔導金國際旗艦組將補助3部國片，並持續各項國片「一條龍」支持計畫，從劇本開發補助、長短片輔導金、國片行銷、映演獎勵等 … 補助最高600萬元，鼓勵好的故事能有更多資源進行田調及孵化，首年開案有52案提出申請，嚴選5案 … 下半年由文化部推出長片輔導金「國際旗艦組」，每案補助最高1億元

figures.finding: Taiwanese films took NT$946 million at the box office in 2025, NT$271 million more than in 2024, an 11.75% market share; three titles passed NT$100 million.

sources.said: 包括《角頭－鬥陣欸》、《96分鐘》、《泥娃娃》等票房均突破億元大關，去年整體國片票房9.46億元，比2024年成長2.71億元 … 達成國片市占率11.75％

figures.finding: Taiwan's Motion Picture Act gave a company investing in a domestic film production enterprise within ten years of 22 May 2015 (holding the shares three years) an income-tax credit of up to 20% of the amount paid, over five years and at most 50% of each year's tax; that window closed on 22 May 2025. No production rebate is set by the Act.

value.base: amount paid for shares of a domestic motion picture production enterprise

figures.applies: Taiwan, Motion Picture Act as amended 2015-06-10.

sources.said: As an incentive to invest in domestically produced motion pictures, a private company that invests in the establishment or expansion of a domestic motion picture production enterprise of a definite size within ten years of May 22, 2015, … and holds the shares for three years or more, may credit a maximum of 20 percent of the amount paid for the share acquisitions against the amount of business income tax payable each year within a period of five years from the then-current year … shall not exceed 50 percent of the amount of the year's business income tax payable in the then-current year;

figures.finding: Taiwan's Ministry of Culture subsidises a foreign film made in Taiwan with 30% of its spend there, at most NT$30 million, where a foreign producer spends at least NT$30 million (an internationally known director NT$3 million); with other public money it may not pass 50% of the spend in Taiwan (rules as amended 20 November 2023).

sources.said: 2. 以國外電影片製作業在我國支出之電影片製作相關費用達新臺幣三千萬元以上資格提出申請。 … 1. 該電影片在我國製作總支出之百分之三十，以新臺幣三千萬元為上限。 … 前列加總本補助不得超過該電影片在我國製作總支出之百分之五十。

figures.finding: The 2026 long-film subsidy (長片輔導金) pays less than 49% of a film's estimated cost, at most NT$100 million (international flagship), NT$50 million (general), NT$25 million (newcomer).

sources.said: 輔導金長片之補助金額，不得達本局核定獲輔導金長片企畫書所載預估製作成本總金額百 分之四十九 … (一)國際旗艦組輔導金上限：新臺幣一億元。 (二)一般組輔導金上限：新臺幣五千萬元。 (三)新人組輔導金上限：新臺幣二千五百萬元。
